job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities

Strong working knowledge of Python, with hands-on experience in web application development.
Hands-on experience with Django and Flask for backend development.
Working knowledge of Node.js; experience with Express.js is an added advantage.
Proficiency in React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML and CSS for frontend development.
Good knowledge of SQL and experience with MySQL or PostgreSQL databases.
Hands-on experience with WordPress, including themes, plugins, customisation and website maintenance.
Working knowledge of Ubuntu/Linux, including command-line operations and basic server configuration.
Basic deployment and server management skills, including Nginx/Apache, SSL, hosting environments and Git.
Experience with REST APIs and third-party API integrations is required.
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues efficiently.
Good communication and teamwork, with a strong sense of ownership, accountability and willingness to learn new technologies



Preferred candidate profile

For MUMBAI based candidates Only!

Strong working knowledge of Python
Hands-on experience with Django and Flask
Working knowledge of Node.js (Express is a plus)
React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML and CSS
SQL (MySQL or PostgreSQL)
WordPress: themes, plugins and customisation
Comfort with Ubuntu/Linux: command line and basic server setup
Basic deployment: Nginx or Apache, SSL, hosting, Git
Good communication, teamwork, ownership and a willingness to learn



Nice to have:

Exposure to AI tools or LLM APIs

Basic SEO and website performance knowledge




Perks and benefits

Work on a variety of client projects as well as our own AI products

A small team, so your work ships fast and matters

Room to learn and grow across the full stack
